goal: Port evidenced 3.6.4 realtime customizations into the existing 3.6.5 installation
constraints: Do not touch env, assets, logs, model files or config
Preserve block_frame, worker, VAD, warmup, crossfade, volume envelope and F0

items.old_behavior: Official 3.6.4 multiplies generated model output by input RMS; local 3.6.4 removes that multiplication
items.required_change: Remove only the final vol_t multiplication
items.risk: Higher output amplitude; verify real model peaks and existing silence branches

items.old_behavior: Local 3.6.4 stores name + host API, accepts legacy prefixes, refreshes before resolving and passes stable labels into backend
items.new_behavior: 3.6.5 uses ordinal-prefixed labels and passes numeric indexes
items.required_change: Shared stable identity resolver, refresh only while stopped, preserve labels through stream creation
items.risk: Duplicate same-name/same-API endpoints must fail rather than guess

items.old_behavior: Local 3.6.4 refreshes before resolution, checks float32/shared sample rate/channels, opens output first, retries same identity and narrowly matched backend fallbacks
items.new_behavior: 3.6.5 dereferences missing devices, opens maximum channel count and reinitializes ASIO after resolution
items.required_change: Adapt evidenced backend code to 3.6.5 block_frame; do not import old read_chunk_size conversion
items.risk: Backend fallback can change latency; log selected API and never guess ambiguous endpoint aliases

items.old_behavior: Local 3.6.4 stops the spawned inference worker on stream failure
items.new_behavior: 3.6.5 leaves worker alive after a failed start
items.required_change: Close partially opened streams and stop worker before clearing state

items.old_behavior: Local 3.6.4 queue and normal stop are identical to official 3.6.4
items.new_behavior: 3.6.5 still uses blocking queue.get in the output callback
items.required_change: No historical Queue port; test current startup/stop blocking before deciding a narrowly necessary safety fix
items.risk: Dropping audio changes continuity; preserve existing stale-drop policy unless independently proven defective

items.old_behavior: Official and local 3.6.4 compare both embedder_model and embedder_model_custom
items.new_behavior: 3.6.5 also compares both; behavioral test confirms folder-A to folder-B reloads once
items.risk: Invalid custom directory can still trigger ContentVec fallback in shared loader; separately verify and fail explicitly in realtime only

items.old_behavior: No local 3.6.4 difference from official tag
items.new_behavior: Hugging Face directory format and final_proj preserved
items.required_change: Local offline model load and inference compatibility checks
items.risk: Actual microphone quality cannot be inferred from synthetic test

execution: Capture official/local comparison and restore copies
Adapt stable backend resolution, validation and lifecycle handling
Prove no silent custom fallback; preserve already-correct path cache
Run regression suite, in-memory compile, imports and offline local-model inference
Report PASS/FAIL/NOT TESTED and manual Windows/Discord steps
rulings: Source changes applied in the explicitly requested installed target, with byte-for-byte backup copies; no worktree, checkout, stash, commit or branch reset was performed.

The old audio_queue was not customized. An independently reproduced empty-queue callback block was fixed as a minimal startup/stop safety prerequisite; oldest-block playback and stale-backlog discard policy retained.
No custom embedder cache fix: observed behavioral test confirms both custom selector and custom path are already compared upstream.
Realtime-only strict embedder loading disables ContentVec fallback for an invalid custom directory; ordinary inference loader defaults retain upstream behavior.
WDF_VIOLATION blue screen interrupted combined hardware verification. No more physical stream or GPU inference tests after reboot; do not claim actual realtime hardware success.

Omit historical automatic WDM-KS fallback after unverified hardware failure. This is a conservative scope choice, not a demonstrated crash fix; explicitly selected WDM-KS devices are not silently remapped.
MME shortened-name aliases require source-side and target-side uniqueness and fresh revalidation on every retry.
Lifecycle control locks never run in audio callbacks. Start generation cancels delayed starts; stream opening and Stop serialize; public refresh rejects starting and running states.
Final safe verification covers all available local tests using unittest; pytest is not installed and no dependency was installed.
